scope: Data audit and preparation only; no exposure or ranking analysis

cleaning.action: Canonical code alignment, explicit axis transposition, documented sums and stacking by year

coverage.overlap_handling: DE-to-DE flows compared exactly and retained in distinct named uses/sales arrays; never summed as disjoint flows

cross_year_alignment: Exact codes, labels and 63-active/one-inactive classification in all 15 years
